message.content: {"findings": [{"cwe": "CWE-22", "class": "Unzip", "method": "initExtractFile", "explanation": "The Zip Slip protection uses String.startsWith on canonical paths without a path-boundary check. For example, if outPath is /tmp/out, an entry named ../out2/evil.txt canonicalizes to /tmp/out2/evil.txt, which startsWith /tmp/out and passes the check. This allows archive entries to be extracted outside the intended directory into sibling directories whose names share the target directory as a prefix. The check should use a trailing file separator or path relativization and reject any canonical path that is not equal to the base directory or a true child of it."}]}
